title: Slides a piece straight to a place
looks: The piece glides in a straight line to the target and stays there.

notThis.diff: rises in an arc instead of a straight line

title: Flies a piece over in an arc
looks: The piece rises above the straight line and drops onto the target.

title: Flies to each stop, then back home
looks: The piece leaves, visits each stop in turn with fading ghosts behind it, and comes back to where it started.

notThis.diff: one move from a dialog to the board, no return
one spiral away with an engine trail, no stops

why: "path" is how it is built; "flight-tour" was read as flight. The piece flies out and comes back where it started.

title: Raises one piece and holds it up
looks: The piece grows a little, its shadow deepens, and it stays raised.

notThis.diff: the whole pile rises while a card leaves it, then sinks back
swells and comes back at once

title: Sets a raised piece back down
looks: The raised piece with its shadow drops, dips a touch under its size and rests flat.

notThis.diff: arrives from nothing, big and transparent

title: Turns a card over by squashing it flat
looks: The card narrows to a sliver, vanishes edge-on and widens again showing the other face.

notThis.diff: turns in perspective, not flat squash

title: Turns a card over in 3D
looks: The card tilts in perspective to edge-on, swaps faces and turns flat again.

notThis.diff: keeps turning on the table plane

title: Grows or shrinks a piece and holds
looks: The piece scales smoothly to the new size and stays at it.

title: Swells a piece once and back
looks: The piece grows a little and returns to its size in one beat.

notThis.diff: starts big and tints the digits

title: Spins a piece round a few turns
looks: The piece rotates about its centre and ends where it started on whole turns.

notThis.diff: keeps turning until the step ends

title: Keeps a piece spinning until the step ends
looks: The piece turns round and round at a steady speed, then snaps upright.

title: Turns a card sideways to show it used
looks: The card rotates a quarter turn and stays sideways.

title: Turns a sideways card upright again
looks: The sideways card rotates back to upright and stays.

notThis.diff: grey copy drains off, no rotation

title: Vanishes in a flash, bursts out at target
looks: The piece flashes bright with streaks, vanishes, and bursts back open at the target.

notThis.diff: the piece flies a visible orbit with a trail; here nothing is seen travelling

why: "collapse" is the source game's word; "shrink-jump" was read as the ship spiral. The strip shows a flash here and a burst there.

title: Beams a token up here, down there
looks: A column of light lifts the token away at the source and a second column sets it down at the target with sparks.

notThis.diff: one column over a piece that stays
shrinks to a flash, no column

why: "warp" is one game's word; the player sees a light teleport.

title: Sends big glowing dots across to a piece
looks: A glowing band of bright dots travels from the source and blooms on the target; the token stays.

notThis.diff: a thin faint line behind a flying piece; no glowing dots, no bloom on the target

title: Zips a token across with afterimages
looks: The token streaks to the target with ghost copies behind it and lands with a small spark.

title: Lifts a token, then flies it straight
looks: The token rises glowing off its place, then travels straight to the target.

title: Sucks a token through a spinning vortex
looks: A swirl opens, the token spirals in and shrinks, and comes out at the target.

notThis.diff: a bright flash and streaks, no swirl

title: Pops an icon into view in place
looks: The icon appears small, overshoots its size and settles.

title: Flashes a piece, then dims it in place
looks: The piece starts large and bright, shrinks back to size and ends in the dim look the game passes.

notThis.diff: a halo fades, no size change

title: Bumps a counter as it changes
looks: The counter jumps large with tinted digits and shrinks back.

title: Spirals a ship off the board, trail behind
looks: The ship banks round a squashed orbit and spirals away or in, a glowing ribbon behind it.

notThis.diff: stops at places and comes home; no engine ribbon
no travel seen, a flash and a burst

title: Fades a piece into view
looks: The piece goes from invisible to fully visible in place.

title: Drops in large and shrinks into place
looks: The piece appears at twice its size, faint, and shrinks to normal as it turns solid.

title: Fades a piece out of view
looks: The piece goes from fully visible to transparent.

title: Shows a piece at once
looks: The piece is just there, with no motion.

title: Hides a piece at once
looks: The piece is just gone, with no motion.

title: Unrolls a panel open from one edge
looks: The panel grows down from a thin strip at its top edge to full size.

notThis.diff: a strip with text that fades away

title: Shuts a panel down to a glowing line
looks: The panel brightens, squeezes to a thin glowing line and goes out.

title: Unrolls a banner with text, then fades
looks: A strip opens over the board, large text appears on it, holds, and the whole banner fades.

title: Fades in text rising into place
looks: A line of text fades in while rising a little and stays.

notThis.diff: appears a word at a time
on a strip that fades away

title: Types out text word by word
looks: The text appears a word or a letter at a time over the step.

notThis.diff: the whole line fades in at once

title: Counts a number up to its new value
looks: The number on the piece rolls from the old value to the new one, slowing at the end.

notThis.diff: same look in the game's own text, from code
the counter jumps, digits do not roll

title: Glows once, then fades back
looks: A soft halo grows round the piece and fades back.

notThis.diff: stays lit until a later step

title: Lights a piece and keeps it lit
looks: A halo grows round the piece and stays until a later glow step turns it off.

notThis.diff: fades back by itself in the same step

title: Dims a lit piece to dark
looks: The piece starts with a halo that fades until it is gone.

notThis.diff: size flash, then a grey look

title: Shakes a piece side to side
looks: The piece jitters left and right a few times and comes to rest.

title: Shakes several pieces together
looks: The listed pieces jitter at once, each a little differently in both directions.

title: Leaves a thin line behind a flying piece
looks: A thin ribbon of light follows the flying piece's route and fades out.

notThis.diff: big glowing dots cross and bloom on the target
a fixed dashed line between two pieces

title: Bursts streaks of light from a point
looks: Thin streaks shoot out from a point (or rush into it) across the board and fade.
why: "radial" is geometry; the player sees a burst of streaks.

title: Raises a pillar of light over a piece
looks: A vertical pillar of light with drifting glitter rises over the piece, lights it, and fades.

notThis.diff: the token is carried away in it

why: "column" is a building word and "beam" reads as a shot; the strip shows a pillar of light.

title: Holds a glowing arc between two pieces
looks: A glowing arc bends from the piece to the target and sparks there.

notThis.diff: a shot travels along the arc and fades; the arc never stays

title: Sweeps a turning wedge of light round
looks: A wedge of light turns round the piece like a lighthouse, then fades.

notThis.diff: a band slides once across the face

why: "rotating-beam" says how it is built; everyone knows a radar sweep.

title: Fires a steady beam at another piece
looks: A straight beam shoots from the source, holds on the target, then fades.

notThis.diff: a short bolt, not a held beam

title: Shoots a fast bolt with a tail
looks: A short bright bolt with a tail streaks from the source and flashes on the target.

notThis.diff: a beam held for a while

title: Lobs a shot along a fading arc
looks: A shot arcs from the source to the target trailing a curved ribbon that fades.

notThis.diff: the whole arc stays lit and sparks on the target; here a short trail travels and fades

title: Heats up, breaks apart, embers rise
looks: The card glows from one point, breaks into small squares, and embers drift up until it is gone.

notThis.diff: pieces lift and turn to smoke

why: "dissolve" hides that it burns; "burn" is what a director types.

title: Card tilts, lifts and burns to smoke
looks: The card tilts and lifts as it burns apart, its pieces spinning off into smoke.

notThis.diff: big shards fly apart; nothing lifts or smokes
only the shield breaks; the card stays

title: Breaks the piece itself into flying shards
looks: The piece cracks, breaks into triangular shards that fly apart and fall.

notThis.diff: a hex shield breaks and the piece stays whole
the card tilts, lifts and turns to smoke; no shards

title: Flashes an oval glint over a hit piece
looks: An oval shimmer flashes over the piece and a ring ripples out from the hit point.

notThis.diff: wide rings blast far beyond the piece; no glint on it

title: Sends a ring outward from a piece
looks: A ring outlines the piece and spreads out as it fades.

title: Blasts wide rings far beyond the piece
looks: Wide rings burst out from the piece, thinning as they grow.

notThis.diff: an oval glint stays tight over the piece
one soft ring hugging the piece

title: Flashes a hex shield as a hit lands
looks: A bubble of hexagon cells lights round the piece with waves from the hit side.

title: Shield cracks away, the piece stays whole
looks: The hex bubble flares at the hit, cracks and scatters into specks.

notThis.diff: the piece itself breaks into big shards

title: Builds a hex shield up cell by cell
looks: Hex cells assemble round the piece, hum and settle.

title: Stamps a label onto a piece
looks: A tilted label slams down from large onto the piece and stays.

title: Stamps a cracked label onto a piece
looks: A label slams down and a jagged crack runs across it.

title: Floats small lights up from a piece
looks: Small glowing dots drift up from the piece and fade at different heights.
why: "motes" is a rare word; the player sees small lights rising.

title: Flickers a colour over a piece
looks: A solid colour flashes on and off over the piece a few times.

notThis.diff: soft fade, repeats until the step ends

title: Buzzes a piece like a bad signal
looks: The piece jitters and its brightness and colour flicker in noisy bursts.

title: Fills a bar from one level to another
looks: A bar inside the piece grows or shrinks between two levels.

title: Moves a numbered pin along a track
looks: A numbered marker lifts, slides along the track and lands with a glow.

title: Clears a used card back to ready
looks: A grey cover drains off the card from the bottom up, leaving the ready face.

title: Pulses a piece in a steady rhythm
looks: The piece dims and brightens again and again until the step ends.

notThis.diff: same from code, outside a beat

title: Bobs a piece gently up and down
looks: The piece floats up a few pixels and back, over and over.

title: Breathes a piece softly in and out
looks: The piece slowly fades a little and back, over and over.

title: Circles little stars round a piece
looks: Small stars circle in an ellipse above the piece, twinkling.

title: Drifts a piece slowly away and back
looks: Over a long period the piece moves and grows a little, then returns.

title: Draws a marching dashed line between pieces
looks: A dashed line joins two pieces, its dashes running from one to the other.

title: Closes target brackets in on a piece
looks: Four corner brackets close in round the piece and fade.
why: "reticle" is a specialist word; the player sees target brackets.

title: Throws small bits out that fall
looks: Small fragments burst from the piece, spin and fall, then fade.

title: Sweeps a band of light across a piece
looks: A slanted band of shine slides across the piece from one side to the other.

notThis.diff: a wedge turns round the piece

why: "sheen" is a rare word; the strip shows a light sweeping across.

title: Fizzles a piece out with grey static
looks: The piece shakes, drains to grey and a noisy sputter crosses it, then recovers.

title: Bursts sparks out from a piece
looks: A spray of sparks flies out round the piece and fades.

title: Slashes strokes across a piece
looks: Bright diagonal strokes cut across the piece and fade.

title: Crumples a card into a ball, throws it
looks: The card folds into a creased ball, is tossed and lands at the target.

title: Glitches a logo with split colour bursts
looks: Every few seconds the wordmark splits into two colours, slices jump sideways and a frame drops.

notThis.diff: on a piece, in a step

title: Zooms the board in and dims around it
looks: The whole board darkens round a point and eases back.

title: Pushes the camera in and back
looks: The whole board grows a little about a point and returns.

title: Slides in cinema bars with a caption
looks: Bars slide in top and bottom with a small caption, hold, and slide out.

title: Draws a crackling orb of energy
looks: A glowing ball of crackling filaments pulses on the piece.

title: Drifts broken card shards across the screen
looks: Triangle shards of art float, spin and fade, in waves.

title: Raises the deck while a card leaves it
looks: The pile rises with a shadow, holds, and settles when the card arrives.

notThis.diff: one piece rises and stays up; no card leaves

title: Moves a dialog card to its board spot
looks: The card moves from an overlay to its place using a browser view transition.

notThis.diff: vanishes in a flash and bursts out
both places are on the board

title: Pulses a live element until stopped
looks: A page element dims and brightens over and over until the game stops it.

title: Keeps a live element bobbing or orbiting
looks: A page element bobs, breathes, drifts or carries stars until the game stops it.

title: Counts a number up in the game's text
looks: A number in the game's own element rolls up to its value, slowing at the end.

notThis.diff: same look on a beat actor

title: Shows banner lines one after another
looks: Lines appear one every 650 ms, the newest fading and growing in.

title: Shakes the screen harder for bigger hits
looks: The whole view jolts and wobbles, harder for more damage, and settles fast.
